concerns.text: Internal contradiction: the table states T009 (manifest) 'executes unconditionally' if the amendment is rejected, but T009 is ordered 'after T004–T008' and its specified content (descriptors, PC scores, exclusion flags from T003/T004) cannot exist without amendment-contingent tasks. The rejection-path manifest is a different, unspecified artifact; define it or drop the unconditional claim.

T006 tags itself [FR-010] while narrowing FR-010's 'the pipeline must abort' to 'abort applies to this stage only' and making the power analysis 'reporting-only, never aborts the pipeline.' This is a semantic weakening of the FR as written in the active spec; the plan flags it for spec revision, but the spec has not been revised, so the task claims to satisfy an FR it partially relaxes. Either revise the spec's FR-010/SC-005 abort scope or mark T006 as satisfying an amended requirement.

T008 tags [FR-007] but FR-007 requires visualizations 'comparing task conditions'; T008's expected path produces a single-group descriptive figure with no comparison. The narrowing is documented in plan.md but the spec still mandates the comparison — the task's coverage claim exceeds what its expected deliverable provides. Spec must define the conditional fallback (plan scope-gap #5) before T008 can honestly carry the FR-007 tag.

T003 substitutes 'documented amplitude-based scrubbing' for the spec's FD > 0.5 mm exclusion rule when no FD column exists, but no amplitude threshold or criterion is specified anywhere, making the >20%-bad-volume exclusion rule untestable on the expected data. Specify the amplitude-based bad-volume criterion (or route it through the spec revision) so the edge-case acceptance criterion survives verifiably.

SC-006/FR-012 require a syntactically valid CSV manifest, but the manifest schema mandates nested object fields (pc_scores, fdr_p_values as mappings), which plain CSV columns cannot represent. No task specifies the CSV encoding of nested structures (JSON-string cells? long format?), leaving T009's 'validated against manifest.schema.yaml' verification ambiguous.

Constitution VII presupposes N≥20 musicians; no task verifies or records the actual subject count in the shard against this floor (the column inventory in T001 records columns, not N). Add an explicit subject-count record so the N≥20 presupposition is checked rather than silently ignored.
